_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ị bụ Onye egwuregwu {player_id} na egwuregwu LinesOfAction.
Egwuregwu gị bụ '{side}', egwuregwu mmegide bụ '{other}'.
Nhazi njem: `[b1b3]` (site na nhazi ruo nhazi). Njem iwu kwadoro na-agafe n'usoro kwụ ọtọ, n'ụkwụ, ma ọ bụ n'ụkwụ ọnụ Ọgụgụ nke mgbidi dị n'usoro ahụ. Ị nwere ike ịwụli elu egwuregwu gị, mana ọ bụghị egwuregwu mmegide; ịdakwasị n'elu mmegide na-ịgba ya.  Merie mgbe egwuregwu gị niile jikọtara ọnụ 8.

invalid_move.identical: Ebe e si enweta ya na ebe a na-aga ya bụ otu.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Ịgagharị agagharị ga-abụrịrị nke kwụ ọtọ ma ọ bụ nke dị n'akụkụ.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: A ghaghị ịkwaga ebe dị anya dịka iberibe n'ahịrị.
invalid_move.destination_own: Ebe a na-aga bụ nke onye ọ bụla n'ime anyị.

game_action.captured_suffix: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id} kwagara {from} -> {to} na-ejide onye iro.
